posts.title: Safari 27.2 Beta Release Notes
posts.text:
## Overview

Safari 27.2 beta is available for iOS 27.2 beta, iPadOS 27.2 beta, visionOS 27.2 beta, macOS 27.2 beta, macOS 26, and macOS Sequoia.

### Accessibility

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed list, table, tree, and canvas content being omitted from the accessible name or description when the containing element is referenced by `aria-labelledby` or `aria-describedby`.
- Fixed VoiceOver repeating text it had already announced when a page streams content by re-rendering an `aria-live` region instead of appending to it.
- Fixed an issue where VoiceOver did not identify `<input type="date">`, `<input type="time">`, and `<input type="color">` controls as pop-up buttons on iOS.

### Animations

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed `animation-range-start` and `animation-range-end` resolving incorrectly when `zoom` is applied, including when the value is inherited from an element with a different zoom factor.

### CSS

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed an issue where an anchor-positioned element inside a modal `<dialog>` could be laid out offscreen and become invisible when the page was scrolled.

#### Deprecations

- Renamed the `flow-tolerance` property to `fit-tolerance` for `display: grid-lanes`, keeping `flow-tolerance` as a deprecated alias that Web Inspector now flags.

### Forms

#### New Features

- Allow combining `safe` and `unsafe` keywords with `normal` alignment, and change `safe` behavior for absolutely (and fixed positioned) boxes to keep the box within their original containing block (the viewport). Fixed an issue where a large picker for a base-appearance `<select>` could render outside the viewport, by applying `safe` alignment to keep it within its original containing block.
- Added `::field-content` to `<select>` to allow styling of the selected option text when `<selectedcontent>` is not provided. Updated alignment of `appearance: base-select` `<select>` buttons to more reliably vertically center its contents. Updated `appearance: base-select` `<select>` buttons to inherit `text-overflow` from the `<select>` to the selected option text. Adjusted `appearance: base-select` `<select>` buttons to use `flex: 1` rather than `::picker-icon { margin-inline-start: auto; }` to manage spacing, ensuring that the picker icon is always visible even when `<selectedcontent>` is not provided. 

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed: Switched default `content` for `appearance: base-select` `<select>` `::picker-icon` to render with a glyph that does not require negative margins to align correctly. 

### HTML

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed the window `load` event never being dispatched when a `readystatechange` handler starts a new load.

### JavaScript

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed `for await...of` over an async generator skipping the `Promise.prototype.constructor` lookup required by `PromiseResolve` when that property is replaced.

### Media

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed an issue where `AudioContext.decodeAudioData()` failed with an `EncodingError` on valid AAC/M4A audio files.
- Fixed video showing a black screen while audio continued to play after the video decoder was invalidated.
- Fixed `ManagedMediaSource` not firing the `startstreaming` event when seeking to a time that is not buffered, which could stall playback.
- Fixed an issue where a media element’s `play()` promise was not resolved when a `SourceBuffer` contained clear, unencrypted content.
- Fixed an issue where the WebCodecs `VideoEncoder` could stall and produce no output for H.264 Main and High profiles.

### Networking

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed cookies set by a top-level navigation’s own response being capped to a seven day lifetime when the site’s hostname is CNAMEd to a different registrable domain.

### SVG

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed dynamic changes to a `<foreignObject>` element’s `x` and `y` values having no effect.

### Safari MCP

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed Safari taking keyboard focus from other apps when creating tabs or capturing screenshots under Safari MCP control. 

### Web API

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed an issue where transient activation could be incorrectly discarded, causing APIs gated on user activation (such as the Clipboard API) to fail on the first attempt.

### Web Extensions

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed a significant delay before web extension content is injected when Safari is cold launched.

### WebGPU

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed a severe frame rate drop when calling `executeBundles()` with render bundles that contain `drawIndirect()` or `drawIndexedIndirect()`.

### WebRTC

#### Resolved Issues

- Fixed an issue where `getUserMedia()` requests for audio permanently failed with `NotAllowedError` after the system audio service was reset.
